title: GitStageAllResult
description: Result of the git.stageAll JSON-RPC method (git add -A, design D19): the fresh post-mutation status. Stage-all is refused while any entry is conflicted — measured, not reasoned: git add -A marks the conflict resolved using the marker-laden worktree file, and a commit follows silently. The refusal is a JSON-RPC error carrying git's domain words, which the panel renders as a visible refusal with the reason.
